memories.author: patient
memories.text: I am a 78‑year‑old male software engineer living in Whitefield. Lately I feel tired, have mild thigh weakness and worry about falling while walking to the market. My daughter helps with groceries. I want to stay active and independent.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment booked for 2025-04-12 at 10:00 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06) for initial geriatric assessment.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: Reports mild fatigue and thigh weakness; walks unaided for ~200 m, uses cane occasionally. cognition: Mini‑Cog 3/5 (recall 2, clock draw normal) – negative screen. falls: No falls in last 12 m; gait steady; TUG 11 s (normal). medicines: 0 regular. mood: Mood good, denies depression. carers: Daughter Priya, primary helper. goals: "I want to keep walking without fear and continue teaching coding workshops."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks, then cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: 25‑hydroxyvitamin D 18 ng/mL (ref 20‑50); serum calcium 9.2 mg/dL (8.8‑10.5); serum phosphate 3.4 mg/dL (2.5‑4.5).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: Fatigue improved, can walk 300 m without aid; mild thigh weakness persists. cognition: Mini‑Cog not repeated (first year). falls: No falls; gait smooth; TUG 10 s. medicines: 1 regular (cholecalciferol). mood: Mood stable. carers: Daughter Priya. goals: "I wish to regain strength for my volunteer tech mentoring."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 4 more weeks, then cholecalciferol 1000 IU OD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: 25‑hydroxyvitamin D 28 ng/mL; calcium 9.4 mg/dL; phosphate 3.5 mg/dL.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: Strength better, walks 400 m unaided; occasional thigh tightness after stairs. cognition: Mini‑Cog not due yet. falls: No falls; gait normal; TUG 9 s. medicines: 1 regular. mood: Mood good. carers: Daughter Priya. goals: "I want to stay fit enough to travel to Mysore next year."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: 25‑hydroxyvitamin D 32 ng/mL; calcium 9.5 mg/dL; phosphate 3.6 mg/dL.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: Reports no fatigue, walks 500 m comfortably; mild thigh stiffness after long walks resolved with stretching. cognition: Mini‑Cog not repeated. falls: No falls; gait steady; TUG 9 s. medicines: 1 regular. mood: Mood positive. carers: Daughter Priya. goals: "I aim to keep my coding club active and stay independent."

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Appointment changed from 2026-04-15 09:00 to 2026-04-15 11:00 due to patient's travel request; still with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: Walks 600 m without aid; reports good energy; no thigh pain. cognition: Mini‑Cog 3/5 (recall 2, clock draw normal) – negative screen (annual). falls: No falls in last 12 m; gait normal; TUG 8 s. medicines: 1 regular. mood: Mood cheerful. carers: Daughter Priya. goals: "I want to continue mentoring young engineers and enjoy gardening."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: 25‑hydroxyvitamin D 35 ng/mL; calcium 9.5 mg/dL; phosphate 3.6 mg/dL.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: Maintains 600 m walk; occasional mild calf tightness after exertion, relieved by rest. cognition: Mini‑Cog not due yet. falls: No falls; gait stable; TUG 9 s. medicines: 1 regular. mood: Mood content. carers: Daughter Priya. goals: "I wish to stay healthy enough to attend my granddaughter’s graduation next year."
